m1-calibrate.imperative: Write a scratch probe that (a) fits ONE real 2023 FP session via fit_grip_baseline_from_laps to observe residual scale, cumulative_track_laps range, n_stints and the reported curve_offset_correlation (calibration), and (b) builds ONE synthetic replicate (injected offset/asymptote/rate + field spread + noise over a realistic cumulative_track_laps axis, realistic stints), calls the REAL fit_grip_baseline_from_laps on it, and prints finite recovered params, reported sigmas, curve_offset_correlation, and an interval-coverage check via predictive_t. Confirms the pipeline is genuinely callable on synthetic data before scaling to >=50 replicates.

m2-harness.imperative: Write tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_grip_synthetic_recovery.py: >=50 replicates varying noise seed AND injected regime (rate / x-window bend), each genuinely calling fit_grip_baseline_from_laps. why_trail.why: Handoff complete (all 8 required sections present). g4 already found the real negative: per-session curve fits are structurally unidentified on FP data (offset<->asymptote corr ~= +-1, absurd offsets). g5 must test that SAME identifiability synthetically with known truth; design must match real session shapes and honestly map recovery/separability vs regime, not force a pass.

Calibrated to real 2023 FP: field-pooled residual RMS ~14-17s (driver spread + uncorrected fuel, NOT iid noise), x_max~460-610, curve amplitude (asymptote) only ~1.5-25s and often absurd, real corr near +-1 on degenerate sessions (Monaco -1.000, Netherlands -0.995) but moderate on others (GB -0.335, Spain -0.745). Mechanism: curve amplitude tiny vs pooled residual -> SNR~0.1 -> offset/asymptote alias. Probe confirms real fit callable on synthetic laps and that even SNR~6 already gives corr -0.89 and biased asymptote. Harness design = regime sweep over SNR (|asy|/noise) x curve-bend, report rates+per-regime breakdown.

Harness built + runs (72 replicates, exit 0). MEASURED: recovery 91.7% (marginal PASS, driven by wide low-SNR sigmas; high-SNR/high-bend only 66.7%), separability 37.5% (FAIL, median |corr| 0.824). Separability failure is intrinsic to the offset+asymptote*(1-exp(-rate*x)) form -> present even at estimator best case and pinned at +-1 wall at real SNR. Independently CONFIRMS g4's real-data identifiability diagnosis synthetically. Honest-null: both rates reported, no assert on the science.

simplification_limits PASS after extracting _regime_summary/_median_abs_corr/_clears helpers from _summarize (was cyclo 20, limit <20). Also hardened seed derivation to a deterministic BASE_SEED*100000+ri*1000+k (was process-varying hash()) so the harness is byte-reproducible; re-verified pytest exit 0 twice with identical rates (recovery 94.4% PASS, separability 31.9% FAIL, median|corr| 0.835). File committable (check-ignore exit 1).
